rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rival counts of the youths contrast with the certainty that God is the fourth of three and sixth of five in His knowledge and presence.
rows.anchor: ما يكون من نجوى ثلاثة إلا هو رابعهم ولا خمسة إلا هو سادسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Each is treated according to station: the youths turn on their sides, while the dog stretches its forelegs at the threshold.
rows.anchor: كل يعامل بما يليق به من حالته ورتبته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dog is fortunate that God repeatedly mentions it alongside the youths and counts it among them.
rows.anchor: كما كرر ذكرهم ، كرر ذكر كلبهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The youths first carried the dog to conceal its tracks; in the end it carried them, as happens to one who follows beloved friends.
rows.anchor: فحملوه ، فكانوا في الابتداء ( بل إياه ) وصاروا في الانتهاء مطايا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In a story, the dog speaks: the youths fear future harm from enemies, while the dog says its present ordeal is being beaten by the friends.
rows.anchor: أنتم تخافون بلاء يصيبكم في المستقبل وأنتم بلائي في الحال

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dog remained at its assigned place and did not exceed its limit, so it stayed with the saints; service etiquette preserves connection.
rows.anchor: لما لزم الكلب محله ولم يجاوز حده فوضع يديه على الوصيد بقي مع الأولياء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The address about fleeing is formally to the Prophet but intended for another; from ordinary human perspective one flees, whereas witnessing God's care lets one remain.
rows.anchor: الخطاب له - - والمراد منه غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading makes the flight fear of being lowered from one's elevated state to their lower state, as a rich person recoils from poverty.
rows.anchor: من أن ترد عن عالي منزلتك إلى منزلتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading is that the observer flees because he does not wish to witness anyone other than God.
rows.anchor: لا تريد أن تشهد غيرنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The youths underestimated their long stay because they were absorbed away from themselves and lacked detailed awareness of their condition.
rows.anchor: استقلوا مدة لبثهم وقد لبثو ( طويلا ) ، لكنهم كانوا مأخوذين عنهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He quotes a poem about an uncertain long night, then says days of union feel short however long they actually are; another poem compares morning and evening sweetness.
rows.anchor: ويقال أيام الوصال عندهم قليلة - وإن كانت طويلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God knows how long they stayed because He is the one who placed them in that state.
rows.anchor: لأنه هو الذي خصكم بما به أقامكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: While absorbed, they had no desire for food, drink, or bodily needs; upon returning to discernment, eating was their first concern, showing food's priority in human constitution.
rows.anchor: ما داموا مأخوذين عنهم لم يكن لهم طلب لأكل ولا شرب ولا شيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The instruction to act gently includes dealing courteously with the person from whom food is bought.
rows.anchor: ليتلطف مع من يشتري منه شيئا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People of spiritual knowledge prefer subtle clothing and fine food, whereas practitioners of ascetic discipline accept coarse dress and food.
rows.anchor: أهل المجاهدات وأصحاب الرياضات طعامهم الخشن ولباسهم كذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The youths urge concealment because outsiders would persecute them by killing, beating, or other means and insist on returning them to their former religion.
rows.anchor: أخبر أنهم إن اطلعوا عليهم وعلى أحوالهم بالغوا في مخالفتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The righteous preserve secrets from outsiders; exposing one's secret to enemies deliberately brings harm and loses what was treasured.
rows.anchor: ويقال من شأن الأبرار حفظ الأسرار عن الأغيار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He compares one who has suffered loss with a person who is not comforted by another's unrelated loss.
rows.anchor: فمن احترق كدسه فما لم يحترق كدس غيره لا تطيب نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God disclosed their story as a sign to later people; witnessing their revival strengthened believers by showing an extraordinary event directly.
rows.anchor: ازداد يقين من كان يؤمن بالله حين شاهدوا بالعيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After the sign, God returned them to their former absorption: beyond discernment, held in God's grasp and consumed from themselves in divine existence.
rows.anchor: مستهلكين عنهم في وجود الحق - سبحانه .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Human knowledge falls short of the youths' hidden states and number; what is concealed in their secrets and hearts is known to God.
rows.anchor: أخبر أن علوم الناس متقاصرة عن عددهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The youths' number is in principle certain, yet people cannot know it by observation; only a few have knowledge of it.
rows.anchor: وعددهم يعلم بالضرورة ، وهم لا يدركون بالمشاهدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dog is fortunate that the verse includes it when the youths are counted.
rows.anchor: ولما ذكرهم عد الكلب في جملتهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The promised reward and resting place are excellent, as are their Lord, home, neighbor, and spiritual state.
rows.anchor: نعم الثواب ثوابهم ، ونعم الرب ربهم ، ونعم الدار دارهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Outwardly, one of two garden owners thanked his Creator while the other disbelieved his Provider; the latter's garden was ruined and he regretted neglecting gratitude.
rows.anchor: فشكر أحدهما لخالقه وكفر الآخر برازقه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the inward reading, two servants are granted ease and divine gentleness; one advances through the stations from good beginnings toward completion.
rows.anchor: يخلق عبدين يطيب لهما الوقت ، ويمهد لهما بساط اللطف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The successful servant's struggle yields good character, then pure spiritual states, and finally self-annihilation in the realities of divine unity.
rows.anchor: فتميز له المجاهدة ثمرات أحسن الأخلاق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The second servant undervalues the good beginning, returns to habits, abandons the path, and falls into heedlessness, separation, expulsion, humiliation, and estrangement.
rows.anchor: فيرتد عن سلوك الطريقة ويتردى في ظلمة الغفلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The one who prefers personal advantage to God's due recognizes his loss and regrets it too late; turning to divine generosity during the worldly lapse could have rescued him.
rows.anchor: قرع باب ندامته ، ثم لا ينفعه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rejected person is bound by abandonment and confused by gradual entrapment, so he misses the chance to seek mercy in time.
rows.anchor: ولكنه ربط بالخذلان ، ولبس عليه الأمر بحكم الاستدراج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As no one aids a person rejected by a king, no king, prophet, friend, or saint can protect one marked by God's abandonment.
rows.anchor: كذلك من وسمه الحق بكي الهجر لم يرث له ملك ولا نبي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sovereignty belongs uniquely to God; when the reality's authority appears, human claims and significance disappear.
rows.anchor: هو الحق المتفرد بنعت ملكوته ، لا يشرك في جلال سلطانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase about allegiance to God can mean power with the initial vowel kasra, or support with the initial vowel fatha.
rows.anchor: هنالك الولاية لله أي القدرة - والواو هنا بالكسر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person who fixes desire on worldly beauty is deceived by its promises and lured by its ambitions.
rows.anchor: من وطن النفس على الدنيا وبهجتها غرته بأمانيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People arrive before God without intercessor, helper, or supporter; the address differentiates those welcomed with peace from those questioned about their deeds.
rows.anchor: جئتمونا بلا شفيع ولا ناصر ، ولا معين ولا مظاهر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some are asked how they are, how they found their resting place, and how eagerly they longed for the meeting.
rows.anchor: كيف أنتم ؟ وكيف وجدتم مقيلكم ؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Others are asked what they did, neglected, sent ahead, delayed, disclosed, and concealed.
rows.anchor: ما صنعتم ، وما ضيعتم ؟ ما قدمتم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Some answer by revealing their inward states and relationship with the Beloved; others are overwhelmed by bewilderment and cannot speak.
rows.anchor: يفصحون عن مكنون قلوبهم ، ويشرحون ما هم به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He cites a poetic line in which Sukayna asks who the speaker is, and he answers that he is one whom she calls her enemy.
rows.anchor: قالت سكينة من هذا فقلت لها : . . . أنا الذي أنت من أعدائه زعموا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One reading says the sinners confront what was written in the first preserved register, while their deeds-register is a copy of what is in the Preserved Tablet.
rows.anchor: إنما يصيبهم ما كتب في الكتاب الأول وهو المحفوظ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another distinction is between those treated according to the divine register of mercy and compassion and those reckoned by the angels' record of their slips.
rows.anchor: من يعامل بما في كتاب الحق من الرحمة . والشفقة وبين من يحاسبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: At resurrection, a past sin appears as if committed in the present, even after many years have passed.
rows.anchor: ما فارقوا الزلة ، وإن كانت مباشرة الزلة قد مضت عليها سنون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Seeing a sin makes the truthful ashamed of falling short; seeing a good deed also shames them for insufficient reverence, and their shame exceeds the heedless person's shame over sins.
rows.anchor: فخجلة أهل الصدق عند شهود حسناتهم توفي وتزيد على خجلة أهل الغفلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The obedient find their deeds bring joy, brightness, a living heart, and relief; transgressors find excess, broken covenant, slips, and bad intent.
rows.anchor: أصحاب الطاعة إذا وجدوا ما قدموا من العبادات فمآلهم السرور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God disclosed a glimpse of Adam's special distinction to the angels, who prostrated through divine enabling; Iblis, veiled and fixated on the outward form, disobeyed.
rows.anchor: أظهر للملائكة شظية مما استخلص به آدم فسجدوا بتيسير من الله - سبحانه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Iblis's claim to be better than Adam was untrue because he disobeyed God's command; primordial wretchedness defeated his stratagem.
rows.anchor: لما فسق عن الأمر ، ولكن أدركته الشقاوة الأصيلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The warning against taking Satan and his descendants as allies implies that one devoted to God does not follow or fear another.
rows.anchor: من يفرده بالولاية فلا يقتفي غيره ولا يخاف غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse refutes astrologers and physicians who claim knowledge from celestial arrangements and natural temperaments: they did not witness creation, so their causal claims lack proof.
rows.anchor: أكذب المنجمين والأطباء الذين يتكلمون في الهيئات والطبائع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People cannot fully know even themselves, much less divine realities and attributes, except through disclosure suited to each person's station.
rows.anchor: إذا تقاصرت علوم الخلق عن العلم بأنفسهم فكيف تحيط علومهم بحقائق الصمدية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People cannot know every state or cosmic fact and need not pursue what has no religious consequence; their concern is God, His attributes, and His rulings.
rows.anchor: ولا حاجة بهم إلى الوقوف على ما قصرت علومهم عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Idols neither benefit, harm, nor help; God will make their uselessness undeniable to end the worshippers' delusion that they bring nearness.
rows.anchor: علم الحق - سبحانه - أن الأصنام لا تغني ولا تنفع ولا تضر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The idolaters claim they worship idols only to bring them nearer to God; the source quotes their stated rationale.
rows.anchor: ما نعبدهم إلا ليقربونا إلى الله زلفى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once delusions end and the fire is seen with certainty, there is no excuse, strategy, intercession, or ransom; despair itself is the greater torment.
rows.anchor: استيقنوا أنهم واقعون في النار ، فلا يسمع لهم عذر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Arguments were made clear to everyone, but some were confused and went astray.
rows.anchor: أوضح للكافة الحجج ، ولكن لبس على قوم النهج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Debating against God's enemies can be praiseworthy, but disputing with God implies resistance to decree and is shirk; a believer's good fortune is being opened to action and spared argument.
rows.anchor: الجدل في الله محمود مع أعدائه ، والجدل مع الله شرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They are not helped toward obedience, yet are neither simply capable nor helpless: if they willed what was commanded it would be withheld; this intermediate state is called takhliya.
rows.anchor: وهذا يسميه القوم حال التخلية وهي واسطة بين القدرة والعجز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Messengers were sent successively with proofs to give glad tidings and warn; some became fortunate by following them and others wretched through opposition.
rows.anchor: أرسل الرسل - عليهم السلام - تترى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The most unjust is one reminded by signs and experienced care—relief, answered prayer, correction after misconduct, or sweetness and ease after obedience—yet later forgets and turns away.
rows.anchor: لا أحد أظلم ممن ذكر ووعظ بما لوح له من الآيات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Persistent turning away results in a covering, heedlessness, and hardness of heart that cuts the person off from granted blessings.
rows.anchor: جعل على قلبه سترا وغفلة وقسوة حتى تنقطع عنه بركات ما وهبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another unjust person receives consequences for past neglect, then accuses and complains against God while forgetting the offense that brought the consequence.
rows.anchor: ويقال من أظلم من يستقبله أمر مجازاة لما أسلفه من ترك أربه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A cited poem says a person wastes opportunity through poor judgment and blames destiny only after it is gone.
rows.anchor: وعاجز الرأي مضياع لفرصته . . . حتى إذا فات أمر عاتب القدرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God is Forgiving because His eternal mercy entails forgiveness; He is merciful to all, while forgiveness is especially for sinful servants.
rows.anchor: ورحمته الأزلية أوجبت المغفرة لهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If God treated people according to their sins, He would hasten punishment, but delays it according to wisdom and ultimately acts by His will and judgment.
rows.anchor: لعجل لهم العذاب ؛ أي عاملهم بما استوجبوه من عصيانهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People were punished for failing to thank blessings and endure trials; alternatively, neglecting the witnessing of decree and contentment left them lost in heedlessness.
rows.anchor: ويقال لما غفلوا عن شهود التقدير ، وحرموا روح الرضا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Joshua merited the honorific title fata through sound companionship with Moses; it denotes a noble quality, not merely an age or label.
rows.anchor: لما صحت صحبة يوشع مع موسى عليهما السلام استحق اسم الفتوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses's search for additional knowledge was a disciplining journey of hardship, so hunger overtook him and he called the travel exhausting.
rows.anchor: كان موسى في هذا السفر متحملا ، فقد كان سفر تأديب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: During the thirty-day wait to hear God's speech, Moses fasted without hunger because that journey was toward God and he was carried by God.
rows.anchor: صبر ثلاثين يوما ، ولم يلحقه الجوع ولا المشقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God caused Joshua to forget the fish so its return to the sea would be an extraordinary sign rather than a human contrivance.
rows.anchor: الله - سبحانه - أدخل عليه النسيان ليكون الصيد من تكلفه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sign was the cooked fish entering the water; this identified where Moses and Joshua would meet Khidr.
rows.anchor: يعني دخول السمك الماء وكان مشويا ؛ فصار ذلك معجزة له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Calling a person God's servant makes him one of the elect; the possessive address “My servant” marks the elite of the elite.
rows.anchor: إذا سمى الله إنسانا بأنه عبده جعله من جملة الخواص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khidr was himself shown mercy by the special gift, and through that mercy he became merciful to God's servants.
rows.anchor: فيكون الخضربتلك الرحمة مرحوما ، ويكون بها راحما على عبادنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ladunni knowledge may be knowledge received by inspiration without laborious acquisition.
rows.anchor: العلم من لدن الله ما يتحصل بطريق الإلهام دون التكلف بالتطلب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It may mean knowledge by which God recognizes His special servants or teaches His saints what benefits His servants.
rows.anchor: ويقال ما يعرف به الحق - سبحانه - الخواص من عباده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It may be knowledge whose benefit goes to God's servants rather than its possessor, in matters belonging to God's right.
rows.anchor: وقيل هو ما لا يعود منه نفع إلى صاحبه ، بل يكون نفعه لعباده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It may be undeniable direct knowledge that is certain despite having no discursive proof; the strongest knowledge is farthest from proof.
rows.anchor: فأقوى العلوم أبعدها من الدليل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses shows courtesy by asking permission to accompany Khidr, then states plainly that he seeks instruction in guidance.
rows.anchor: تلطف في الخطاب حيث سلك طريق الاستئذان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khidr's special knowledge was not learned from a teacher, raising the question how someone could teach it to another.
rows.anchor: لم يكن تعلمه من أستاذ ولا من شخص

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khidr explains Moses cannot patiently endure what he has not comprehended through experience.
rows.anchor: وكيف تصبر على ما لم تحط به خبرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses made two promises: patience qualified by God's will, which he kept, and obedience stated unconditionally, which he failed to keep.
rows.anchor: فأما الصبر فقرنه بالاستثناء بمشيئة الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A disciple should not say no to a spiritual master, a student to a teacher, or a layperson to a jurist issuing a ruling.
rows.anchor: فإنه ليس للمريد أن يقول ( لا ) لشيخه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khidr damaged the boat to preserve its owners' property from the king who would seize sound ships; Moses's question describes the outcome, not an intent to drown them.
rows.anchor: وكان ذلك إبقاء على صاحبها لئلا يرغب في السفينة المخروقة الملك الطامع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses views the event through knowledge, while Khidr acts from the judgment and hidden ruling of the matter.
rows.anchor: أنت تنظر إلى هذا من حيث العلم ، وإنا نجزيه من حيث الحكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses invokes the rule that forgetfulness is not culpable and asks not to be burdened; obligation applies only where action or omission is possible.
rows.anchor: لأن الناسي لا يدخل تحت التكليف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses had to object to apparent injustice under outward law, yet knowing Khidr's state required him to pause until he learned whether the act was forbidden or permitted.
rows.anchor: حيث يرى في الظاهر ظلما ولكن فيما عرف من حال الخضر من حقه التوقف

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khidr repeats his warning because Moses's condition was to ask only with knowledge, while Moses had stipulated that another question would end their companionship.
rows.anchor: كرر قوله : { إنك لن تستطيع . . . } لأنه واقف بشرط العلم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Three questions mark the transition from the final number of a few to the beginning of many, so Khidr no longer grants leniency.
rows.anchor: والثلاثة آخر حد آخر حد القلة ، وأول حد الكثرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The village was religiously obligated to host them; Moses did not know that criticizing the villagers would be fruitless and would have done better to overlook their refusal.
rows.anchor: كان واجبا في ملتهم على أهل القرية إطعامهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses does not accuse Khidr of wrongdoing in repairing the wall without pay; he says taking wages on their behalf would have been better for them.
rows.anchor: فلو أخذت بسببنا لكان أخذك خيرا لنا من تركك ذلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses also asks why Khidr denied their right to compensation if the villagers owed them a right.
rows.anchor: ولئن وجب حقهم فلم أخللت بحقنا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses's earlier journey to water Shuayb's daughters involved greater hunger and fatigue, but he was then carried rather than tested through endurance.
rows.anchor: حين سقى لبنات شعيب فإن ما أصابه من التعب وما كان فيه من الجوع كان أكثر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khidr says the stipulated question means no further companionship; he is holding Moses to the condition Moses himself imposed.
rows.anchor: فلما قال موسى هذا قال له الخضر : أي بعد هذا فلا صحبة بيننا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, Khidr says Moses is a prophet and he holds him to his own stated condition.
rows.anchor: ويقال قال الخضر إنك نبي . . وإنما أؤاخذك بما قلت

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Unable to bear Moses's repeated questions, Khidr also chose not to continue companionship and preferred separation.
rows.anchor: ويقال لما لم يصبر موسى معه في ترك السؤال لم يصبر الخضر أيضا معه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses tolerated the first two questions because they concerned others' rights, but questioning the wall and food involved his own interest and brought separation.
rows.anchor: فلما صار في الثالثة إلى القول فيما كان فيه حظ لنفسه من طلب الطعام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Moses sought Khidr's company to gain knowledge, while Khidr preferred solitude with God over company with creatures.
rows.anchor: فإن الخضر كان يحب ترك صحبة موسى عليه السلام إيثارا للخلوة بالله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khidr explains that damaging the ship protected its owners: a damaged vessel was better than a sound one confiscated by the king.
rows.anchor: فبقاء السفينة لأهلها - وهي معيبة - كان خيرا لهم من سلامتها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khidr explains the boy's death by the prior decree that his continued life would tempt his parents, while a replacement would bring them happiness.
rows.anchor: أن في بقائه فتنة لوالديه ، وفي إبدال الخلف عنه سعادة لهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Khidr repaired the wall to preserve the two orphans' treasure and avoid seeking compensation from people.
rows.anchor: أما تسوية الجدار فلاستبقاء كنز الغلامين وترك طلب الرفق من الخلق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people's eastern and western locations become an inward image of degrees of tawhid: some are illumined by presence and witnessing, while others receive only a small share.
rows.anchor: كذلك الناس في طلوع شمس التوحيد : منهم الغالب عليهم طلوع شموسهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gog and Magog could not understand others' speech, so they communicated their grievance through their own language and offered tribute for help.
rows.anchor: ما كانوا يهتدون إلا إلى لسان أنفسهم ، وما كانوا يفقهون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Dhul-Qarnayn accepted their request and built the barrier without taking the promised levy, since protecting them was his duty as far as he could manage.
rows.anchor: ولم يأخذ منهم ما ضمنوا له من الجباية ، لما رأى أن من الواجب عليه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He asked them for iron pieces, had them heat and blow on it, and formed a barrier between the two mountain slopes.
rows.anchor: قال : { ءاتونى زبر الحديد } فلما فعلوا ما أمرهم به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The barrier lasts until God permits Gog and Magog to emerge at the appointed time, after which God determines their course; their emergence is a sign of the Hour.
rows.anchor: إنما يبقى ذلك إلى أن يأذن الله له في الخروج

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They look with their physical eyes after losing the heart's sight of reflection; deprived of guidance, they cannot hear with acceptance though legally addressed.
rows.anchor: نظروا بأعين رؤوسهم لأنهم فقدوا نظر القلب من حيث الاعتبار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The statement that they cannot hear means God withheld the hearing that would enable acceptance.
rows.anchor: فلم يستطيعوا لهم القبول

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Idolaters imagine their worship benefits them, invoking idols as a means to nearness, but God reveals the opposite of their expectation.
rows.anchor: وكانوا يقولون : { ما نعبدهم إلا ليقربونا إلى الله زلفى }

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The losers' efforts are wasted because they worked for other than God, so their deeds do not benefit them.
rows.anchor: ضل سعيهم لأنهم عملوا لغير الله . وما كان لغير الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another account identifies them as people who mix deeds with ostentation and self-admiration, undoing good through self-regard or reminding others of favors.
rows.anchor: الذين قرنوا أعمالهم بالرياء ، ووصفوا أحوالهم بالإعجاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A further account describes people who scrutinize their deeds and regard them with self-importance rather than seeing them as small.
rows.anchor: هم الذين يلاحظون أعمالهم وما منهم بعين الاستكثار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: They lack spiritual verification and act without knowledge or certainty, blinded to truth and left in delusions, with no weight in the next life.
rows.anchor: لم يكونوا أصحاب التحقيق ، فعملوا من غير علم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their condition reverses across time: present denial and separation become future rejection and burning, while the elect have immediate gardens of union and future gardens of grace.
rows.anchor: اليوم هم في ذل الفراق ، وغدا في أليم الاحتراق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The elect remain eternally in paradise and vision without expulsion or veil; meanings of God's words have no end because eternal attributes have unlimited objects.
rows.anchor: فهم أبدا في الجنة ، ولا إخراج لهم منها . وأبدا لهم الرؤية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Prophet resembles people in outward form and kind but is distinguished by God's selection for revelation and messengership.
rows.anchor: أخبر أنك لهم من حيث الصورة والجنسية مشاكل

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Taking hope of meeting God literally is preferable: all believers long to meet Him, and the gnostic hopes for the vision of God.
rows.anchor: ولكن ترك هذا على ظاهره أولى ؛ فالمؤمنون قاطبة يرجون لقاء الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The righteous act for meeting God through patient endurance of longing and sincerity; they do not admire deeds or claim their own power.
rows.anchor: وأن يخلص في عمله . { ولا يشرك بعبادة ربه } : أي لا يلاحظ عمله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading makes the righteous work belief in the bridge and awaiting its time.
rows.anchor: ويقال العمل الصالح هنا اعتقاد وجود الصراط ورؤيته وانتظار وقته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opening invocation portrays God's name as noble and central to service, effort, love, witnessing, and the inward life of the righteous and free.
rows.anchor: اسم عزيز جبلت القلوب على محبته ، وكل قلب ليس يوقفه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who hear and recite the disconnected letters are the good, while the Messenger alone is given their inward meanings and secret.
rows.anchor: حروف خص الحق المخاطب بها بفهم معانيها ، وإذا كان للأخيار

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kaf signifies God's sufficiency in giving and requital, raising and lowering by decree; it also signals nearness to friends and warning about hidden trial.
rows.anchor: أشار بالكاف إلى أنه الكافي في الإنعام والانتقام ، والرفع والوضع

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Kaf also points to God's writing mercy upon Himself before angels record His servants' sins.
rows.anchor: في الكاف إشارة إلى كتابته الرحمة على نفسه قبل كتابة الملائكة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ha signals guidance to knowledge of God and instruction to the elect; ya signals ease after hardship and a hand extended in mercy.
rows.anchor: والهاء تشير إلى هدايته المؤمنين إلى عرفانه ، وتعريف خواصه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ayn signals God's knowledge of the servant's hidden and public state, quantity, outcome, capacity, and need; sad signals truthfulness in His promise.
rows.anchor: والعين تشير إلى علمه بأحوال عبده في سره وجهره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God specially answered Zachariah's request for a son, extending devotional nearness to his descendants and household.
rows.anchor: تخصيصه إياه بإجابته في سؤال ولده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zachariah concealed his prayer from outsiders so they could not inspect his state or gloat; humility could also conceal it from himself.
rows.anchor: فأخفى نداءه عن الأجانب وقد أمكنه أن يخفيه عن نفسه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zachariah's weakness and gray hair mean he has become unable to serve as he wishes, so he asks for a son to take up worship in his place.
rows.anchor: أي لقيت بضعفي عن خدمتك ما لا أحبه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zachariah asks confidently because God loves being asked and had repeatedly answered his prayers in the past.
rows.anchor: إني أسألك واثقا بإجابتك ؛ لعلمي بأني لا أشقى بدعائك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He fears prophethood will leave his household for his cousins, so he asks for a child who will worship God and belong to his family.
rows.anchor: إني خفت أن تذهب النبوة من أهل بيتي

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He did not seek a child for worldly pleasure but to continue God's due; inheritance means a surviving son who inherits prophecy and conveying revelation from Jacob.
rows.anchor: وهو لم يرد الولد بشهوة الدنيا وأخذ الحظوظ منها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The request that the child be pleasing can mean God is pleased with him, or that the child is deeply content with God and His decree.
rows.anchor: رضي فعيل بمعنى مفعول أي ترضى عنه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Yahya's name signifies life: the child will revive his barren mother, lineage, memory, and the household's worship and prophecy.
rows.anchor: تحيا به عقرة أمه ، ويحيا به نسبك ، يحيا به ذكرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Having no namesake signals Yahya's singular excellence and lack of an equal in the totality of his virtues.
rows.anchor: انفراده - عليه السلام - بالتسمية يدل على انفراده بالفضيلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another interpretation says he had no peer because no one else was without sin before and after prophethood.
rows.anchor: لم يكن أحد لا ذنب له قبل النبوة ولا بعدها غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zachariah's question reflects a long interval between asking for a child when younger and receiving the answer at advanced age.
rows.anchor: بين سؤاله الولد وبين الإجابة مدة طويلة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, he asks which woman will bear the child: his barren wife or another woman he might marry.
rows.anchor: أمن هذه المرأة وهي عاقر أم من امرأة أخرى أتزوج بها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Conception at this time is both a miracle and a sign to Zachariah's people, while also being comfort and honor for him.
rows.anchor: في هذا الوقت الذي فيه حسب مستقر العادة ولادة مثل هذه المرأة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's statement that He created Zachariah before when he was nothing indicates that a nonexistent thing is not a thing.
rows.anchor: دلت الآية على أن المعدوم ليس بشيء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sign concerns conception, not proof of God's promise: for three days Zachariah cannot speak to people, though he can pray, read scripture, and praise God.
rows.anchor: إن لسانك لا ينطق معهم بالمخاطبة - ولو اجتهدت كل الجهد - ثلاثة أيام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When he emerges from the sanctuary, Zachariah signals his people that the tongue he uses to address them is not functioning.
rows.anchor: عرفهم - من طريق الإشارة - أن اللسان الذي كان يخاطبهم به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The command to take the Book with strength means strength of heart, not physical force; God specially granted it as prophecy.
rows.anchor: لا قوة يد ولكن قوة قلب ، وذلك خير خصه الله تعالى به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse indicates that Yahya had a revealed book.
rows.anchor: ودلت الآية على أنه كان من الله له كتاب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Wisdom may mean prophecy bestowed on Yahya while still a child.
rows.anchor: أي النبوة ، بعثه الله بها إلى قومه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, wisdom means judging people by what is right and true.
rows.anchor: ويقال الحكم بالصواب والحق بين الناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A further reading defines wisdom as carrying out an act in accordance with its command.
rows.anchor: ويقال الحكم هو إحكام الفعل على وجه الأمر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God-given compassion and purity include purification and enabling for both acquired piety and piety bestowed directly by divine grace.
rows.anchor: فإن التقوى على قسمين : مجموع ومجلوب يتوصل إليه العبد بتكلفه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Yahya was dutiful to his parents because God commanded it, not merely from human affection or customary family feeling.
rows.anchor: كأمر الله - سبحانه - له بذلك لا لمودة البشر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He was not rebellious against truth or denying God's lordship.
rows.anchor: ولم يكن متمردا عن الحق ، جاحدا لربوبيته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: His peace at birth, death, and resurrection means protection from deviation and doctrinal error in life and from trial in the afterlife.
rows.anchor: يصونه عن الزيغ والعوج في العقيدة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary withdrew from her people to attain purity and privacy; seeing Gabriel in human form frightened her, so she sought refuge in God.
rows.anchor: اعتزلت عنهم لتحصيل يطهرها ، فاستترت عن أبصارهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary invokes the Merciful as the one who protects her through mercy from Gabriel.
rows.anchor: بالذي يرحمني فيحفظني منك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, she means that if Gabriel knows God and fears disobedience, she seeks God's protection and fears His punishment.
rows.anchor: إن كنت تعرف الله وتكون متقيا مخالفة أمره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Gabriel calms Mary and announces Jesus; her question about having a child despite no wrongdoing is answered by God's unrestricted power.
rows.anchor: فلا يتعصى ذلك على الله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus will be a sign of God's complete power and a mercy to believers, while becoming a cause of error for others.
rows.anchor: ويكون هذا الولد رحمة منه - سبحانه - لمن آمن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When Mary learned she was pregnant, she feared people's suspicion and had no trusted person to whom she could disclose the secret.
rows.anchor: ولم تثق بأحد تفشي إليه سرها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary went to a distant place, and the pains of childbirth forced her to lean against a palm trunk.
rows.anchor: مضت إلى مكان بعيد عن الخلق . ألجأها وجع الولادة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Mary's wish to have died may express shame and fear that her people would slander her.
rows.anchor: داخلها الخجل من قومها نطقت بلسان العجز

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One explanation is that she feared her people would condemn her and accuse her of fornication.
rows.anchor: لأنها علمت أنهم سيبسطون لسان الملامة فيها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another explanation is compassion for her people, lest punishment come upon them because of her.
rows.anchor: قالتها شفقة على قومها لئلا تصيبهم بسببها عقوبة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: She may have wished to die before people made Jesus a divine son and Mary God's spouse.
rows.anchor: حتى لم أسمع من قال في الله تعالى بسببي إن عيسى ابن الله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another reading is that she longs for the earlier period when she was cared for and had not faced this hardship.
rows.anchor: في الوقت الذي كنت مرفوقا بي ، ولم تستقبلني هذه الخشونة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The voice from beneath Mary may have been Gabriel or Jesus; its purpose was to ease her loneliness and announce the noble child.
rows.anchor: أن المعني بقوله { من تحتها } : جبريل عليه السلام ، وقيل عيسى عليه السلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A dry palm trunk produced ripe dates immediately, a sign that the One able to do this could create Jesus without a father.
rows.anchor: وكان جذعا يابسا أخرج الله تعالى منه في الوقت الثمرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Unlike the unbidden provision Mary found with Zachariah, she was told to shake the dry palm while weak, showing that worldly causes entail effort.
rows.anchor: فلما جاءت علاقة الولد أمرت بهز النخلة اليابسة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, her ability to shake the tree made her truthfulness more evident; God also ensures His elect are not abandoned in need.
rows.anchor: وكان تمكنها من ذلك أوضح دلالة على صدقها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God supplied Mary's food and drink, eased her fear, and comforted her heart; she was to signal her vow of silence if she saw anyone.
rows.anchor: كفاها أسباب ما احتاجت إليه من أكلها وشربها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The people may call her sister of Aaron because her brother was named Aaron.
rows.anchor: ويقال كان أخوها اسمه هارون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, Aaron was a dissolute man and they call Mary his likeness in corruption.
rows.anchor: ويقال كان هارون رجلا فاسقا في قومهم ، فقالوا : يا شبيهته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, Aaron was a righteous man; the people invoke her supposedly righteous parents to condemn this grave event.
rows.anchor: ويقال كان هارون رجلا صالحا فيهم فقالوا : يا أخت هارون

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus says peace upon himself, unlike the Prophet's greeting during the Night Journey, and peace means safety.
rows.anchor: قال عيسى عليه السلام : { والسلام على } وقال لنبينا عليه السلام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus is safe at birth from Christians' excessive praise and Jews' disparagement, and safe at death and resurrection from trials outside divine union.
rows.anchor: فلست كما قالت الطائفتان جميعا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: People divide over Jesus: some reject him and others accept him, but their disagreement concerns whether he merits divinity.
rows.anchor: وقد شك فيه أكثر الخلق فرده قوم وقبله قوم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The true statement is that God cannot literally have a child: He is one, a child would be part of a parent, He needs no spouse, and adoption is impossible without shared kind.
rows.anchor: لا يجوز أن يكون له ولد على الحقيقة ؛ لأنه واحد ، والولد بعض والده

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: When God wills a thing, He creates it by power and the command of origination; no possible thing resists Him.
rows.anchor: إذا أراد إحداث شيء خلقه بقدرته ، وخاطبه بأمر التكوين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jesus was ordered to declare God as his and their Lord, convey his message, and command worship according to God's law.
rows.anchor: أمرني بتبليغ رسالتي ، واتباع ما شرع الله من العبادات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those whose nature was mixed with felicity obey now and are not lost later; those excluded by prior decree are not brought near by later service.
rows.anchor: ومن أقصته القسمة السابقة لم تدنه الخدمة اللاحقة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the end, their knowledge becomes unavoidable, their conditions are overturned, and neither their pleas nor cries receive mercy.
rows.anchor: تصير معارفهم ضرورية ، وأحوالهم كلها معكوسة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The Day of Regret comes suddenly upon people unprepared, who mourn what they missed.
rows.anchor: تقوم الساعة بغتة ، وتصادفهم القيامة وهم غير مستعدين لها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Alternatively, the Day of Regret is the primordial allotment when misery and happiness were decreed before either group had committed deeds.
rows.anchor: ويقال يوم الحسرة يوم القسمة حين سبقت لقوم الشقاوة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's inheriting the earth does not mean He newly acquires kingship; He already owns all the earth and everything in it.
rows.anchor: وليس يريد به استحداث ملكه ، وهو اليوم مالك الأرض ومن عليها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Zachariah's hope that a son inherit contrasts with Israel inheriting land and God inheriting earth: there is a great difference between a child heir and God.
rows.anchor: فشتان بين من وارثه الولد وبين من وارثه الأحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A Muslim can face death easily knowing God will inherit him; martyrs remain alive because God is their heir.
rows.anchor: ولا تحسبن الذين قتلوا فى سبيل الله أمواتا بل أحيآء

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A truthful one is abundant in truth without admixture, sincere in words, deeds, and states, inwardly consistent with outwardly, and steadfast with God.
rows.anchor: الصذيق الكثير الصدق ، الذي لا يمازج صدقه شوب

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The deity must possess hearing and sight perfectly, without deficiency; the same standard applies to power over benefit and harm.
rows.anchor: على استحقاق المعبود الوصف بالسمع والبصر على الكمال دون نقصان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: No created being can originate or create; attaching the heart to a creature or imagining even a sliver of independent efficacy resembles idol worship.
rows.anchor: كل الخلق لا تصلح قدرة واحد منهم للإبداع والإحداث

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham urges his father to follow because truth is more strongly with him despite his younger age; salvation is following truth's people, ruin lies in innovation and false paths.
rows.anchor: أمره باتباعه لما ترجح عليه جانبه في كون الحق معه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Satan's disobedience to the Merciful is why Abraham refuses to worship him; one should never obey someone who disobeys God.
rows.anchor: العلة في منعه من عبادة الشيطان عصيانه للرحمن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Shunning people of disobedience is a foundation of religion.
rows.anchor: أساس الدين هجران أرباب العصيان

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham showed every form of compassion, but repeated counsel did not help his father because later effort cannot undo a prior decree of exclusion.
rows.anchor: لم يغادر الخليل شيئا من الشفقة على أبيه ، ولم ينفعه جميل وعظه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham's father threatened him after Abraham offered a gracious promise of good; Abraham answered from settled insight while still retaining hope.
rows.anchor: فأجابه الخليل بمقتضى سكون البصيرة

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: After despairing of his father, Abraham was consoled by pious descendants granted prophethood and enduring good remembrance.
rows.anchor: لما أيس من أصله آنسه الله بما أكرمه من نسله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Abraham's devotion was wholly sincere: neither blame nor temptation to favor himself turned him from God.
rows.anchor: مخلصا خالصا لله ، ولم يكن لغيره بوجه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Private supplication has merit beyond public calling; Abraham's story combines calling at the start with intimate address later, with God caring for him throughout.
rows.anchor: للنجوى مزية على النداء ، فجمع له الوصفين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase about the side of the Mount refers to Moses, who was standing on the side of the mountain.
rows.anchor: ترجع إلى موسى فموسى كان بجانب الطور

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: One of Moses's special gifts was that his brother Aaron was made a prophet.
rows.anchor: من خصائص موسى أنه وهب له أخاه هارون نبيا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ismail was true to his promise by keeping his pledge to endure his father's sacrifice until the ransom appeared.
rows.anchor: كان صادق الوعد إذ وعد من نفسه الصبر على ذبح أبيه

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ismail commanded his family to pray and give alms by God's command, encompassing bodily and financial worship in every circumstance.
rows.anchor: ويشتمل هذه على أمره إياهم بالعيادة البدنية والمالية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Being accepted and pleasing to God is Ismail's most honored quality.
rows.anchor: وكان عند ربه مرضيا } وكان هذا أشرف خصاله وأجل صفاته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A truthful one is abundant in truth without admixture, stands for truth and God, and has no motive for anyone else.
rows.anchor: الصديق كثير الصدق ، لا يشوب صدقه مذق

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Idris was raised to an exalted rank in spiritual formation unmatched by anyone.
rows.anchor: درجة عظيمة في التربية لم يساوه فيها أحد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's favor lies in choosing people's inward states and preparing them for their final rank; their tender hearts bow inwardly as well as outwardly when verses are recited.
rows.anchor: أخبر أن منته كامنة في تخصيصهم بأحوالهم ، وتأهيلهم لما رقاهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their outward distinction keeps the etiquette of servanthood while inward union realizes divine lordship; those who abandon the path and law will face what they deserve.
rows.anchor: فبوصف التفرقة قاموا بحق آداب العبودية ، وبنعت الجمع تحققوا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Those who repent, believe, and act rightly enter paradise without injustice; primordial mercy fulfills its promises and they hear only peace, as their hearing is guarded from otherness.
rows.anchor: فأولئك الذين تداركتهم الرحمة الأزلية ، وسيبقون في النعم السرمدية

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God's promise is sure because what you come to has in a sense come to you, or what comes to you is what you approached.
rows.anchor: لأن ما أتيته فقد أتاك أو ما أتاك فقد أتيته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Paradise food morning and evening is an idiom for the time interval, since poor people often obtained only one of the two daily meals.
rows.anchor: إن وجدوا غداءهم ففي الغالب يعدمون عشاءهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Paradise provision differs by recipient: bodies receive food and drink, spirits receive audition and vision, each in proportion to its share.
rows.anchor: فللأشباح رزق من مطعوم ومشروب ، وللأرواح رزق من سماع وشهود

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Paradise is prepared for the pious of this community, while mercy is reserved for sinful Muslims; paradise is God's favor and mercy His attribute.
rows.anchor: الجنة لطف من الله تعالى ، والرحمة وصف لله تعالى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A servant singled out by God is one who remains under His command in the present life.
rows.anchor: فعبده على الخصوصية من كان اليوم في قيد أمره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Piety has degrees: avoiding sins, sensual desires, heedlessness, or witnessing anything other than God.
rows.anchor: قوم يتقون المعاصي والمخالفات ، وقوم يتقون الشهوات

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Angels descend only by God's command, to aid the oppressed, rescue the distressed, destroy deniers, support believers, and attend countless other matters.
rows.anchor: فبعضهم بإنجاد المظلومين ، وبعضهم بإغاثة الملهوفين

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God does not neglect either rejector or worshipper: He preserves and blesses, or grants respite and punishment.
rows.anchor: والله - سبحانه - لا يترك جاحدا ولا عابدا من حفظ وإنعام

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Since God brings things into existence and has power over them, He is their Lord and owner; an act belongs to its agent insofar as its existence lies within its power.
rows.anchor: وإذا وجدت فهو فاعلها ، فمعنى كون فعل الشيء لفاعله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If God is Lord of powerful great ones, He is also Lord of the small and weak; a servant's value derives from the owner, not intrinsic status.
rows.anchor: وقيمة العبد بمالكه وقدره ، لا بثمنه في نفسه وخطره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Worship means standing wherever God commands and relinquishing personal inclination, opinion, and planning.
rows.anchor: قف حيثما أمرك ، ودع ما يقع لك ، وخل رأيك وتدبيرك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: To persevere in worship is to reach the utmost limit of patience.
rows.anchor: الاصطبار غاية الصبر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God has no namesake in the sense of an equal or peer; no one else bears the name Allah, and none can resemble Him in pre-eternity.
rows.anchor: هل تعلم له سميا } : أي كفوا ونظيرا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God has no likeness, whether existent or merely imagined; resemblance would imply equality.
rows.anchor: والتشبيه يقتضي التسوية بين المتشابهين ، ولا مثل له

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Against denials of resurrection, God adduces the first creation: He brought weak humans from their parents' loins and wombs and delivered them when He willed.
rows.anchor: أقام الحجة عليهم بالنشأة الأولى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse supports people of insight in affirming that a nonexistent thing was not a thing during its nonexistence.
rows.anchor: فيه دليل على صحة أهل البصائر أن المعدوم لم يك شيئا
